solutions.source: let segmentSums (head:list_node option) = let rec values acc = function None -> List.rev acc | Some (n:list_node) -> values (n.value::acc) n.next in let rec collect total active acc = function [] -> List.rev (if active then total::acc else acc) | 0::xs -> collect 0 false (if active then total::acc else acc) xs | x::xs -> collect (total+x) true acc xs in List.fold_right (fun v tail -> Some {value=v;next=tail}) (collect 0 false [] (values [] head)) None
